responsibility: Say whether this member may take this book, and for how long.

inputs.book: { isbn: string; title: string; copies: number; onLoan: number }
inputs.member: { id: string; name: string; onLoan: number; suspended: boolean }

reason.description: Why not, or why it is a short loan. Empty when there is nothing to say.

dueInDays.description: 0 when the book is not going anywhere.
